collection.title: GHRSST Level 4 MUR Global Foundation Sea Surface Temperature Analysis (v4.1)

dataset.access: Harmony sds/HOSS-geographic (bbox + temporal + variable subset, NetCDF-4)
dataset.auth: NASA Earthdata Login required (Harmony token or ~/.netrc)

fetch_guards: Only the MUR requests listed in rois[].mur_requests may be sent; no global or unlisted bbox. Large ROIs are split into tiles of at most max_request_cells, each tied to the ROI.
Reject (and do not keep) any response whose lat/lon lie outside that request's expected_extent_w_s_e_n.
Reject any response whose cell count per day differs from that request's expected_cells.
Only pixels in the ROI membership table enter the daily aggregates; the rest of the rectangle is discarded.

assumptions.grid: MUR v4.1 cell centres lat = -89.99 + 0.01*i (i<17999), lon = -179.99 + 0.01*j (j<36000); consistent with UMM-Var dimensions but not stated in metadata. Verify (and latitude order) in pilot.
assumptions.subset_shape: Harmony HOSS bbox subset returns every grid cell whose extent intersects the request bbox, one output file per daily granule.
assumptions.transfer_ratio_low: lowest observed global ratio granule_bytes / uncompressed_bytes (CMR sizes).
assumptions.transfer_ratio_expected: median observed global ratio; coastal subsets have less land fill, so this may be optimistic.
assumptions.transfer_ratio_high_why: HOSS output compression is not documented in metadata; assume none.
assumptions.file_overhead_why: NetCDF-4 header, attributes and lat/lon/time coordinate arrays per output file.
assumptions.job_granularity: one Harmony job per ROI x month (temporal + bbox + variable subset).
assumptions.concurrency_in_flight_batches: execution.concurrency ROI-month batches at HIGH size, plus their .part copies.
assumptions.processing_scratch: one batch of masked float32 arrays per in-flight batch (uncompressed, 4 bytes/cell/variable).
assumptions.row_size_why: schema-based model of the daily aggregate table (see FINAL_SCHEMA); no calibration sample yet.

calibration.variables_in_pilot: analysed_sst, analysis_error, mask, sea_ice_fraction (backfill requests fewer, so per-file sizes are a slight overestimate)

fetch_guards: Open each dataset once per region (surface level, region box); every chunk is read once.
ARCO chunks are large tiles (BGC 8x16 deg, PHY 2.7x5.3 deg): bytes on the wire cover the tile, but only cells inside each ROI request box are kept; the rest is never written to disk.
Reject a response whose coordinates fall outside the region box or whose shape differs from the plan.
Keep only membership cells marked sea in the static mask; refuse to run while zones_without_sea is non-empty.
Write no rows for zone x dataset pairs in unavailable_by_decision; record them as unavailable in the output.
unknowns: Copernicus Marine Toolbox may also read coordinate arrays and .zmetadata (a few KB per dataset).
ANFC days near the present are revised; values for the last weeks may change after download.

Coarse model grid (0.25 deg BGC, 1/12 deg PHY) versus 5 km coastal zones: at most one BGC cell lies mostly inside a ROI, so BGC values describe ~28 km cells around the zone. Land cells are identified by the static mask.

imerg.access: Harmony sds/HOSS-geographic (bbox + temporal + variable subset, NetCDF-4); Earthdata Login
fetch_guards: Only the boxes in imerg.rois[].requests may be sent to Harmony.
Reject any file whose cells are not the approved request's 0.1 deg grid cells.
Only cells in the ROI membership table enter the daily aggregate.
unknowns: Late Run values are replaced by the Final Run ~3.5 months later; Late is the only run covering this period.
0.1 deg cells are larger than the 5 km zones: zone values are those of the surrounding cells.

T2M.name: Temperature at 2 Meters
T2M.definition: The average air (dry bulb) temperature at 2 meters above the surface of the earth.

RH2M.name: Relative Humidity at 2 Meters
RH2M.definition: The ratio of vapor pressure to the saturation vapor pressure with respect to a plane surface of pure water, expressed in percent.

WS10M.name: Wind Speed at 10 Meters
WS10M.definition: The average of wind speed at 10 meters above the surface of the earth.

WD10M.name: Wind Direction at 10 Meters
WD10M.definition: The average of the wind direction at 10 meters above the surface of the earth.

ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN.name: All Sky Surface Shortwave Downward Irradiance
ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN.definition: The total solar irradiance incident (direct plus diffuse) on a horizontal plane at the surface of the earth under all sky conditions. An alternative term for the total solar irradiance is the "Global Horizontal Irradiance" or GHI.

ALLSKY_SFC_PAR_TOT.name: All Sky Surface Total PAR
ALLSKY_SFC_PAR_TOT.definition: The total (direct plus diffuse) Photosynthetically Active Radiation (PAR) incident on a horizontal plane at the surface of the earth under all sky conditions.

CLOUD_AMT.name: Cloud Amount
CLOUD_AMT.definition: The average percent of cloud amount during the temporal period.

power.access: POWER daily point API, JSON, no account
power.point_rule: zone polygon representative point (inside the zone)
unknowns: POWER publishes recent days with a lag; those days come back as fill and are stored empty.
POWER cells (0.5-1 deg) are much larger than the zones.
